CIRCULATORY SYSTEM TYPES

  • The circulatory system is the transport system that carries nutrients, gases, hormones, and waste products through the body. The type of circulatory system is a key classification axis for animals.

Two Types

#### 1. Open Circulatory System

  • No vessels to contain the blood — blood flows freely through the body cavities (haemocoel).
  • E.g. Arthropoda, Mollusca (most).

#### 2. Closed Circulatory System

  • Blood is always contained within vessels as it circulates through the body.
  • E.g. Annelida, Chordata.

Quick Reference

TypePhyla
OpenArthropoda, Mollusca (most)
ClosedAnnelida, Chordata

Note on Human Circulatory System

The human circulatory system is detailed in 08 - Circulatory System and Excretory System (heart, blood vessels, blood composition, double circulation). This chapter covers the comparative-phylum view; the human-specific content lives in ch 8.

Key concepts

  • Open (Arthropoda, Mollusca) | Closed (Annelida, Chordata)
